slide.title: repin --onto checks every edit before writing any
slide.takeaway: repin --onto now shares accept-proposed's evidence path: every edit, plain or apply-slide, is validated before the first write.

item.label: The bug: repin --onto failed on apply-slide slides
item.description: repin --onto read every evidence record as a file, so a managed slide's #items/.../evidence/N record failed with no such file, after it had already rewritten some plain evidence files.

item.label: prepareEvidenceEdits validates everything first
item.description: writeEvidenceEdits is split: prepare reads and edits every plain file in memory and dry-runs each managed slide's complete-slide update, returning its results; nothing is written.

item.label: One locked write for plain evidence and the landing
item.description: repin --onto now prepares first, then under one Saga lock re-edits the plain files from disk, writes them, the companion cursor, the frozen review and the merge record. The unused referenceKeyBefore goes.

item.label: Managed slides publish after the locked write
item.description: Each prepared complete-slide request is applied for real; accept-proposed and refresh-coverage keep using writeEvidenceEdits, now with the same prepare-then-write order.

item.label: Two regression tests
item.description: One re-pins a managed slide and a plain file onto a landed commit; the other revises the slide's story so its update is refused, and checks no evidence, pin or merge record was written.

slide.title: repin --onto checks every edit, then writes under one lock
slide.takeaway: repin --onto validates every edit, writes under one lock, and records only the landing's own commits with its real merge date.

item.label: The bugs: partial writes and extra merge-record commits
item.description: repin --onto read apply-slide evidence as files and failed after rewriting some; and its merge record listed every commit reachable from any pinned evidence, so freezing an older landing pulled in later commits.

item.label: prepareEvidenceEdits validates everything first
item.description: Every plain evidence file is edited in memory and every managed slide's complete-slide update is dry-run; every refused slide is reported at once with its apply-slide repair command, dry runs included.

item.label: Every write shares one Saga lock
item.description: Under one lock every edit is checked again against the disk, then slide updates, plain evidence, the cursor, frozen review and merge record are written in that order; slide transactions gain a locked variant.

item.label: The merge record lists only the landing's commits
item.description: A pinned commit counts only if it is an ancestor of the landed commit, of a merge's second parent, of --branch or of the frozen review's head; evidence pinned later or on another branch no longer counts.

item.label: A frozen review keeps its landing's facts
item.description: merged_at is the landed commit's committer date, not the time of the freeze, and a review created against an exact commit (a stacked review) keeps that base.

item.label: Regression tests
item.description: A managed slide re-pinned onto a landing; a refused slide named with its repair on --dry-run and for real; an injected write failure leaving no landing; an older landing recording only its own commits.
